name: @kyvora/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Kyvora (common + identity + product domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle directory --output src/.bundled/directory.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle directory --output src/.bundled/directory.json && redocly bundle subjects --output src/.bundled/subjects.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle subjects --output src/.bundled/subjects.json && redocly bundle consents --output src/.bundled/consents.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle consents --output src/.bundled/consents.json && redocly bundle attestations --output src/.bundled/attestations.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle attestations --output src/.bundled/attestations.json && redocly bundle screening --output src/.bundled/screening.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle screening --output src/.bundled/screening.json && redocly bundle disputes --output src/.bundled/disputes.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle disputes --output src/.bundled/disputes.json && redocly bundle settlement --output src/.bundled/settlement.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle settlement --output src/.bundled/settlement.json && redocly bundle audit --output src/.bundled/audit.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle audit --output src/.bundled/audit.json
